name: SikaRoof® VersiJack® CK Base Slope Corrector

breadcrumb.name: SikaRoof® VersiJack® CK Base Slope Corrector

tagline: SLOPE CORRECTOR FOR HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM
summary: SikaRoof® VersiJack® CK Base Slope Corrector is an accessory used to accommodate slope corrections arising from falls created on concrete surfaces for drainage purposes. Slope correctors are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and can correct for slopes from 1% to 5%. SikaRoof® VersiJack® CK Base Slope Corrector is used in conjunction with either SikaRoof® VersiJack® or SikaRoof® VersiJack® K and is installed at the base of pedestals. This allows for more stability especially at higher heights as the pedestal is standing upright.
